8.3 Iceberg: UMIR has no 'iceberg' term (gap G20); written as C, with UMIR 'disclosed volume' quoted only to note hidden volume is not displayed.
8.3 Stop-order mechanics (trigger, buy-stop above / sell-stop below market) are C; GN-URPART7-25-0003 quoted only for triggered-stop-becomes-market-order and limit-price encouragement.

8.4 Order-error correction process: no CIRO rule or guidance in corpus (gap G22); prose limited to UMIR 6.4(2)(c) journal-entry adjustment, IDPC 3815 recording of modifications/cancellations and IDPC 3945 supervision of excessive cancellations. Unsourced 'industry practice' sentence removed in fix round 1.
8.4 Client FX conversion: no CIRO rule on dealer conversion rates/spreads in corpus (gap G22); written as C; only GN-3800-21-003 FX-rate disclosure recommendation is quoted.
8.4 Marketplace examples (TSX) and book-entry delivery through the clearing agency (CDS) are C; NI 21-101 defines 'marketplace' but names no marketplaces.

8.5 'Special margin situations' has no defining text (gap G24); presented as an umbrella with each example quoted separately (control blocks, concentration, LSERM convertibles, registered-account debits, guarantees).
8.2 Insider trading: Ontario Securities Act used as the example; other provinces' statutes and the AMF whistleblower programme are not in the corpus, so no claim is made about them.
